nodes.label: Accessible reactive credential form
nodes.rationale: Touched invalid controls expose linked error messages and ARIA invalid states; submission is disabled while busy. The template presents required-field and length errors for user IDs and passwords.

nodes.label: Demonstration-only banking and security claims
nodes.rationale: Encryption, fraud monitoring, and privacy statements are explicitly presentation claims, not external certification. Local development provides no TLS, no real money moves, and the demonstration has no affiliation with BPI.

nodes.label: Demo recovery and security guidance dialog
nodes.norm_label: demo recovery and security guidance dialog
nodes.rationale: Account recovery is unavailable in this demonstration. The dialog directs users to seeded credentials and Facilitator Reset for locked accounts, and warns against sharing passwords or financial identifiers.

nodes.label: Idle-session countdown and keep-alive dialog
nodes.rationale: The dialog warns that inactivity will cause sign-out, exposes a countdown, and offers keep-alive or immediate logout. Dialog cancellation is intercepted to invoke keepAlive.
